speaker: john_heminges
text: The afternoon is off the stage. You were Egeon, Will. Both ends. The book is open for the week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Both ends. If the share is a share, say the share. I have not come to write a coffer under it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thirty-five shillings. Your part, of the company, for the week to today.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thirty-five is a clean figure. You will call it a share, and you will walk it home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A share. Last Saturday was thirty-eight. This Saturday is thirty-five. They are neighbours. I will not marry them into a quarrel.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Nor I. A smaller week does not apologise to a larger one. Write thirty-five.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You may write it. I have had my afternoon. I am not in the sum, and I am not in the coat you wore.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Wednesday's eightpence stays where it was entered. We are not agreeing it again.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The eightpence stands. The hired men stand at their ten shillings. Neither is a new sum at this table.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Christmas is not in this column. No date, and no figure. I am not standing up to name a night we have not been given.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The blank stays a blank. Expected stays expected. I will not write a sum beside a hope.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Monday is the Navarre comedy, and you are in it. Thursday is the king again, and you are in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard Monday, and I heard Thursday. I will not write a hope beside either.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Thirty-five shillings, received. Not a balance. I have said share. I have not sliced the company to make the arithmetic feel finished.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You have the figure. The king was Thursday. This was the old comedy. Do not spend the rest of the reckoning telling us a page.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. There is one page at home, and it is not this book. You will get no leaf of it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A man who says he will not, and then does not, can keep his purse. I am for home when the boxes shut.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Home, and not a story about thirty-five. Drinking a figure is how a figure becomes a speech.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick's morning was yesterday. It is not a line in this book. Nobody prices it. It is not done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is not done. He spoke. The call is where it was. That is not a share.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then thirty-five is the news. I will not hear a stock turned into a balance to make the share look earned.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is not a balance. Shut, and entered. Thirty-five. The blank left blank.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will enter it as received. The two lines will not be married into one total.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Enter it, and go. You have evening prayer, if the book is right, and a supper after. A week with a blank in it does not need a toast.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No toast. The lodging has the book.

speaker: will_kemp
text: No toast. You said it plain. That is enough from me.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Enough from all of us. Thirty-five. Go and be a parishioner.
